Subject: POC success criteria & kickoff cadence (Nova Health)

Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before the kickoff: 

1) Objective: Validate that Redwood Inference reduces mean token cost by >= 25% for Nova’s customer support reranking workflow while maintaining <= 150ms 95th-percentile generation latency for 512-token sequences.

2) Proposed POC scope (2 weeks):
- Week 0 (prep): dataset ingest, access & security review, baseline metrics collection (current cost/latency on your infra).
- Week 1: run Redwood hosted trial with prefix caching + 4-bit quantized model variant, daily sampling & quality checks.
- Week 2: run scale validation with synthetic concurrency up to 50 rps, final readout & decision criteria review.

3) Success criteria (pass/fail):
- Cost: >=25% reduction in per-token inference cost (measured across the evaluation sample).
- Latency: 95th <= 150ms under steady-state load.
- Quality: top-1 reranking precision drop <= 2% vs your baseline.

4) Roles / owners:
- Nova: Ellen (POC sponsor), Tom (platform/infra lead)
- Redwood: Jordan (eng lead / single point of contact), Lauren (eng ops / onboarding), Marcus (solutions / eval metrics)

5) Artifacts: mutual action plan, data checklist, baseline metric snapshot, evaluation script. I attached a first draft "novah-poc-plan-v1.pdf" and the MAP spreadsheet for your review.

Next steps: Can you confirm Tom’s availability for a 30-minute kickoff on Monday (Nov 9) 10:00–10:30 PT? If Monday doesn’t work we can do Tuesday. Also confirm the dataset subset we should ingest (we recommended ~5k anonymized threads).

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Jordan Blake
